annotations.title: Get Listing Compliance Event History (Deficiency, Hearing, Panel, Suspension)

description: History of exchange listing events for one company, or market-wide, on Nasdaq, NYSE and NYSE American, read from SEC filings (8-K, 6-K, Form 25), company press releases and exchange records: deficiency notices, Staff Delisting Determinations, hearing requests and stated intents, stays, Hearings Panel exceptions, grants and denials, second compliance periods, trading suspensions, regained compliance and Form 25 removals under Exchange Act Rule 12d2-2(b). Each event has eventType, eventDate, standards, the rule cited, a deadline only when the exchange or an accepted plan states it (deadline.basis), on a Staff Delisting Determination a hearingRequestDeadline computed by Signal8 as the letter date plus 7 calendar days (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5815(a)(1), with its basis), hearing and suspension dates, and the source filing link (source.url, source.edgarUrl). It answers questions such as when a company got its delisting determination and what happened after. A null field means not measured. An empty list means nothing on record in the window, never that the company is in compliance.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive (default 30 days ago; at most 730 days back with a ticker, 90 without).

ticker.description: Only this company (matched by ticker or CIK). Omit for market-wide.
